design_problem: CONTROLLED_L03_DIRECT_QUESTION_CLAUSE is validated as a bounded slot in the interrogative shell, but no clause pattern is yet authorized to occupy it. Payload must therefore be governed explicitly rather than inferred from STR001, STR002, arbitrary clauses, subject/person, or content-interrogative constructions.
design_rationale: A closed allowlist prevents the validated KE shell from becoming an accidental universal question wrapper.
An empty initial allowlist preserves the current evidence gap instead of fabricating a clause payload.
Each future payload can be reviewed on its own evidence, scope and provenance without changing the interrogative shell.
Subject/person and content-interrogative systems remain independent until separately governed.
governance: Design approval does not authorize any actual clause payload.
STR001/STR002 remain excluded unless separately proposed and validated for this slot.
No AN/EN or KU/KUVAN automatic admission.
No productivity promotion, curriculum mapping, OPI/QA or runtime action.
